newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Sendzimir steel mill mulls Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish Sendzimir steel mill mulls Eurobond issue.

text.p: Poland's state-owned steel mill Huta Sendzimira SA, which has began preparations for privatisation, wants to tap international markets with a dollar eurobond issue later this year, the mill's president, Tadeusz Knapik, said on Monday.

"The Sendzimira steel mill is interested in setting a eurobond issue worth several dozen million dollars, the issue would be probably arranged by one of foreign banks with experience in East and Central Europe issues," he said.
Knapik said the proceeds from the issue would be used to restructure the mill's debt. They would be listed in either in London or New York.
He said the issue should also help lift the company's profile ahead of its planned privatisation.
"The Eurobonds would radically improve the perception of the mill on international financial markets," Knapik said.

The mill, which last year earned net 14.3 million zlotys on sales of 2.9 billion zlotys and which employs 17,500 workers, plans to start its privatisation this year by carving out three units to be offered to equity investors.
